title: Allow User Abort [Off]
description: Best-practice rule — flags Allow User Abort [Off] steps. Disabling abort can trap the user in a long or looping script with no way out.
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: With user abort off, a runaway loop cannot be cancelled with Esc/⌘-.
rule.remediation: Re-enable user abort once the protected section ends, or add an explicit exit.
